decisions.reason: As a low-cost aesthetic extension of the core drainage range that stayed on the site after launch, it still offers option value with little extra commitment and fits the firm's design-led positioning.
This product is tightly aligned with the firm's core know-how and barrier-free bathroom trend, and its continued dedicated presentation suggests the option remains valuable and not yet disproven.

Although the pump-based concept is more complex and adjacent to an earlier dropped offering, it is still a recent launch, so the uncertainty has not fully resolved and the firm would likely keep it one more year to learn before committing or exiting.
